claims.statement: ADR-0001 declares accepted decisions, accepted specifications, and implemented change contracts immutable.
The v2 manifest hashes every change contract but does not record the status that determines whether a base change is already immutable.

GitHub Actions run 30033872965 rejected the human-accepted CHG-0002 transition from approved to implemented as a mutation even though governance, quality, build, packaging, and evidence recording otherwise completed.

H-032: The governance host can preserve complete change-contract history while allowing a base contract that is not yet implemented to evolve, by resolving and hash-verifying each base change blob and freezing bytes only when that base contract is already implemented.

H-032 is supported for the tested Git-backed governance host at signed head e6a5f52b1d9dba7718d5914fdcf6aa80b9d63ea5: every historical change identity remains present, base blobs are schema-, identity-, and SHA-256-verified, contracts implemented in the base are byte-immutable, non-implemented contracts may evolve while current bytes remain manifest-bound, and missing status evidence fails closed. The evidence does not establish field-level mutation rules for proposed or approved contracts, a new manifest schema, cross-VCS behavior, or acceptance of H-031.
claims.evidence: Human Doctrine acceptance on 2026-07-23 after local refutation and GitHub Actions Constitution run 30036275462

claims.statement: This Slice does not establish field-level mutation rules for proposed or approved contracts, migration to a new manifest schema, cross-VCS behavior, or acceptance of H-031.
